narr: A big push of monsoon moisture immediately followed the excessive heat event, and stormy conditions persisted into August. Many storms produced flash flooding, and some produced severe weather.
ev: Hackberry Rd was closed from Hwy 66 to I-40.
Sycamore Camp Rd was closed from Burro Creek Crossing to mile post 9.
Oatman-Topock Hwy was closed just north of I-40.
Pierce Ferry Rd was closed due to flooding of the Archibald Wash.
Flooding of Short Creek closed several streets in Colorado City.
Antares Rd was closed from Hwy 66 to Pierce Ferry Rd.
Hualapai Mountain Rd was flooded with water and debris.
Cottonwood Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to mile marker 16.
Greggs Hideout Rd was closed from Pierce Ferry Rd to mile marker 10.
Huffriter Crossing was closed from Hwy 93 to Back Rd.
Pump Station Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to Back Rd.
Bogles Ranch Rd was closed from Upper Trout Creek to Bogles Ranch.
Signal Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to Alamo Rd.
Banegas Crossing was closed from Hwy 93 to Banegas Ranch.
Flash flooding in Golden Valley closed several roads and resulted in one swift water rescue of a stranded driver.
Several streets flooded in the Riviera and Rotary Park neighborhoods.
Seventeen Mile Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to Signal Rd.
Burro Creek Crossing was closed from Hwy 93 to mile post 14.
Numerous roads in and south of Golden Valley were closed due to flooding.
Flash flooding closed numerous roads in Golden Valley and also left water and debris on Hwy 93.
